$comment: Example configuration. Copy to agentic-sdlc-config.json and fill in your own values. Every field is described under _fields. Leave the board fields empty to run without a GitHub project board.

_fields.workflowDir: Directory for committed workflow state (items, logs). Default .workflow.
_fields.github.repo: owner/repo for issues and PRs. Empty means auto-detect from the git remote with gh.
_fields.github.owner: User or organization that owns the GitHub Projects v2 board.
_fields.github.projectId: Board node ID (PVT_...). Read it with: gh project view <number> --owner <owner> --format json --jq .id
_fields.github.statusFieldId: Node ID (PVTSSF_...) of the board's Status single-select field. Read it with: gh project field-list <number> --owner <owner> --format json
_fields.boardStatus: Option IDs of the Status field for backlog, ready, in-progress, in-review and done, from the same field-list output.
_fields.modelRouting: Model used for easy, medium and hard stories.
_fields.pm.adapter: Where work items are stored. 'server' uses the local workflow server and falls back to files when it is not running. 'github' also writes GitHub issues (mutates GitHub).
_fields.workflow.autoMergePlanPR: Merge the plan PR without waiting for a human.
_fields.workflow.autoMergeDesignPR: Merge the design PR without waiting for a human.
_fields.workflow.maxCostPerRun: Cost ceiling in USD for one run. null means no ceiling.
_fields.server: Workflow server port (0 picks one from portRange), idle shutdown in minutes, and log level.
_fields.reviewStrategy.skipPerStoryReview: Skip per-story review for stories at or under maxDifficulty that carry requireLabel.
_fields.briefing: Sources and depth for the briefing skill.
